Diagnosis: Conflicting position constraints: freeze_position was specified twice (indices 0 and 3) in violation of the rule that only one position operator is allowed across the Constraints list.
Reasoning: Success for this subtask requires: (1) keeping both the tool (gripper) position and orientation fixed in the world frame so the gripper does not move during the release (this justifies use of freeze_position and freeze_orientation—both targeting the panda_fingertip, the only robot end-effector frame); (2) commanding the gripper fingers to open fully so that the released object can be dropped (open_gripper required). All should be logically 'and', as the action requires all criteria to be satisfied simultaneously. The previous constraint list incorrectly included freeze_position twice, which is disallowed. There is no supported operator in the TermAPI schema to directly verify contact force (manipulator_low_effort) or object release feedback. Therefore, the constraints should be limited to freezing the pose and opening the gripper.
